mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS applyId, a.period_id AS periodId, p.title AS periodTitle, a.item_id AS itemId, i.name AS itemName, a.apply_user_id AS applyUserId, au.real_name AS applyUserName, a.title, a.amount, a.reason, a.expect_date AS expectDate, a.attach_file_id AS attachFileId, a.status, u.real_name AS auditUserName, a.audit_time AS auditTime, a.audit_remark AS auditRemark, a.create_time AS createTime FROM budget_apply a LEFT JOIN budget_period p ON a.period_id = p.id LEFT JOIN budget_item i ON a.item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON a.apply_user_id = au.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.audit_user_id = u.id WHERE a.id = #{applyId} AND a.deleted = 0
SELECT e.id AS expenseId, e.title, e.amount, e.expense_date AS expenseDate FROM budget_expense e WHERE e.apply_id = #{applyId} AND e.deleted = 0

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approvedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejectedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 1 THEN a.amount END), 0) AS approvedAmount FROM budget_apply a WHERE a.period_id = #{periodId} AND a.deleted = 0
